x: Graham Taylor, who set a magnificent course record of 1hr.39m.47s. the previous year, was unfortunately prevented from turning out by injury, and with the withdrawal by Peter Yates, the race seemed from the start to lie between Scottish international Jim Wright of Tipton, and Barry Collins of Surrey AC.

Blackheath's Richardson won by a mere couple of strides from Watson (Cambridge H.), both having run fast enough to have been over a quarter of a mile clear of the field in any of the previous 18 races, apart from that of 1966 when Graham Taylor set the remarkable course record of 1:39:37.
